title_zh: 微軟執行長 Satya Nadella 長文
title_en: Satya Nadella · "Models as Insider Risks in the Super Intelligence Era"

en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella, in a new long essay,
argues AI models should be managed as an internal risk to the company.
Models are more capable than traditional software, yet can't explain why they act the way they do.
Yet we already let agents touch sensitive data and make critical decisions.
It's not that the model is malicious, but any role with permissions
can make mistakes or be compromised.
So the supply of intelligence must be separated from control.
Control has to sit outside the model. The model can't police itself.

zh: [[是最不需要信任模型的那一個。]]
end_card.en: The most trustworthy system is the one that needs you to trust the model the least.
end_card.by: ── 整理自 Satya Nadella〈Models as Insider Risks〉
